title: Keep derived auto-grid row sizing consistent across creation, edits and loading
answers: Why does minimum panel height behave differently after loading a dashboard?
Where must auto-grid row sizing be updated when minimum height changes?
How does a single panel opting into fit content affect grid rows?
body:
Mechanism: Grid autoRows is derived from row height, fill-screen mode, fit-content presence and minimum height through public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/layout-auto-grid/AutoGridLayoutManager.tsx:getAutoRowsTemplate.
Creation and edits: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/layout-auto-grid/AutoGridLayoutManager.tsx:AutoGridLayoutManager passes the initial minimum; updateAutoRows passes the current minimum, and onMinHeightChanged invokes updateAutoRows after updating state.
Loading: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/serialization/layoutSerializers/AutoGridLayoutSerializer.ts:deserializeAutoGridLayout passes the resolved minimum and enables fit row growth only when auto-height panels are enabled and either the layout default or any child explicitly opts into fit content.
Invariant: Keep these inputs and recomputation paths in sync. Omitting the minimum during creation or loading restores the row-height floor; skipping recomputation after an edit leaves stale row sizing.
applies: Changes to auto-grid minimum-height settings, derived row templates or layout deserialization.
